measurement_notes: Frozen W04 chooser and W05 artifact association workflow have different datasets; measurements establish bounds, not a speed improvement or timing SLA.
Each list remains 50 rows after paging. W05 begins at 459 DOM nodes and the selected/paged excerpt workflow has 487, rather than accumulating page bodies.
Active excerpt query cleanup removes its query and transport validator when the page changes or reader unmounts. This is code plus focused validator tests; no browser heap-size claim is made.
Regression runs preceded the final W05-only scoped table CSS correction. The complete W05 suite, offline gate and screenshots were rerun after it.
